race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SHORTS FURY (6) makes most appeal on debut after winning a recent Toowoomba Inner Track trial, and the Stephen Massingham-Ryan Wiggins pairing adds further confidence given their strong records here. With limited race experience across the field, that trial readiness gives her the edge to make an immediate impact. MR STRONG (3) has the best exposed excuse from his Townsville debut, where he was bumped at the start, raced wide throughout and was still only beaten just under six lengths behind Castle Hill. Improver who comes into calculations. SO SUNNY (8) also comes through that race, was near the top of an open market, raced wide and still finished just ahead of MR STRONG, so the 2kg claim keeps her firmly in the mix. GREY DEVIL (7) was safely held on debut but had steering issues and interference, and the 1.5kg claim helps. Capable of sharp improvement.
